post.content:
Look where I am 👀 One of the most invaluable experiences I've had on the GenGlo journey so far, and we haven't even launched yet. 🤯🚀

Through CEW UK's incredible two-way mentorship programme, I was paired with Chelsey Saunders, who has been an absolute game-changer. Not only has she been an amazing mentor, but she connected me with Charlie Wright and Samantha Mayhew, the brilliant minds heading up the skincare buying team within the medicated aisles at Boots UK.

I made the trip up to Nottingham to visit their HQ, and honestly it was like stepping into another world. The Boots timeline wall alone was worth the journey. Such a powerful reminder of the legacy and scale of this brand.

We had a really rich conversation. We talked about the growing male skincare market, something Boots has been seeing firsthand both in-store and online, and why GenGlo's inclusive, gender-neutral approach is not only timely but genuinely important. While women remain the majority of skincare buyers, the shift is happening, and being part of that conversation early feels significant.

We also discussed what it actually takes for an early-stage brand like GenGlo to get noticed and eventually stocked by a retailer like Boots. The milestones, the strategy, the standard of excellence required. Hearing that from the people who make those decisions? Priceless.

I left Nottingham with my head full of ideas, a clearer roadmap, and an enormous amount of gratitude. To have access to such talented, generous people at this stage of building GenGlo is a privilege I don't take lightly.

Thank you Chelsey, Charlie, and Sam, and thank you CEW for making connections like this possible. 🙏

#GenGlo #CEW #Boots #Skincare #Mentorship #InclusiveBeauty #FounderJourney #MaleSkincare #GenderNeutral #StartupLife #BeautyIndustry
